problems.source_says: The paper explicitly supplies suggestions to Late-AI participants in Round 2, but does not establish whether Early-AI participants could still access their earlier suggestions while producing their final submissions. Figure 1 shows when suggestions were introduced, without resolving continued access. Thus with_ai is supported for Late-AI final outputs and Early-AI Round 1, but not established for the Early-AI final results included under all five outcomes. The form correctly acknowledges this uncertainty in its prose and mixed flag, yet retains one with_ai question code covering the unresolved results. Under the codebook rule based on availability during production, Early-AI Round 2 availability and question should remain null pending evidence; after_ai is likewise unconfirmed.
problems.quote: Early-AI and Control participants proceeded without new external inputs.
problems.locator: PDF pp. 3-4 (printed pp. 10282-10283), Section 3.4 and Figure 1; creativity-codebook.md, Section 1, lines 11-17, and Section 6, line 109.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 through S1-O4 concern produced submissions assessed by three environmental-policy or innovation-management experts using 7-point scales; ICC >= 0.80 is printed. These are not self-reported outcomes.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 3.5; PDF pp. 5-6 (printed pp. 10284-10285), final sentence of Section 4.4.

confirmed.statement: The constructs overall_creativity, novelty, usefulness, and novelty respectively match S1-O1 through S1-O4; the paper separately rates and tests novelty and originality.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Sections 3.5 and 4.1; creativity-codebook.md, Section 6, lines 75-85.

confirmed.statement: S1-O1 matches Section 4.1: Early-AI-Labeled M = 6.01, SD = 0.48; Control M = 4.94; omnibus F(4, 237) = 37.54, p < .001, partial eta-squared = .38. The stated Early-AI superiority and Late-AI improvement over Control are also in the prose.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 4.1; Figure 2a on PDF p. 5 plots condition levels without exact mean labels.

confirmed.statement: S1-O2 through S1-O4 exactly reproduce the component tests: novelty F(4, 237) = 30.75, p < .001; usefulness F(4, 237) = 51.64, p < .001; originality F(4, 237) = 1.10, p = 0.358.

S1-O5 is computed on participant submissions with text-embedding-ada-002 and cosine comparisons to supplied GPT-4 suggestions. Construct other and measure embedding_similarity are supported; this does not compare different people or count categories within a person.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 3.5; creativity-codebook.md, Section 6, lines 81-98.

confirmed.statement: S1-O5 matches Section 4.1: Early-AI-Labeled distance M = 0.59; Control M = 0.84; F(4, 237) = 85.53, p < .001, eta-squared = .59. The form preserves the printed effect-size label and lower-distance interpretation.

S1-O5 labeling statistics match: .61 versus .73, t = -11.04, p < .001, d = 1.58. The contextual correlation is r = -0.35, p < .001; perceived external influence is correctly excluded as a separate scored-output outcome.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (printed p. 10284), Section 4.2; PDF p. 4, Sections 3.4-3.5.

confirmed.statement: Section 4.4 prints the retained changes: creativity up to +0.88, t = -19.69, p < .001, d = 1.73; Early-AI-Labeled +0.17; Control +0.14; Late-AI semantic-distance change -0.23. The text leaves the exact Late-AI arm or aggregation unspecified.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (printed p. 10284), Section 4.4; S1-O1 and S1-O5 before_after contrasts.

confirmed.statement: Source limitation: Figure 2e shows a steeper Early-AI-Labeled creativity trajectory than either Late-AI trajectory, conflicting with the prose attribution of the largest gains to Late-AI. The form’s change numbers are supported by the prose, not exact numerical labels in that figure.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (printed p. 10284), Figure 2e creativity panel and shared condition legend, compared with Section 4.4.

confirmed.statement: Every Table 1 slope, SE, and p-value retained in S1-O1 matches the PDF: Control (-0.012, 0.031, .687); Early-Labeled (.117, .035, .005); Early-Unlabeled (.159, .033, < .001); Late-Labeled (.093, .037, .029); Late-Unlabeled (.118, .036, .005). These are moderator slopes.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5 (printed p. 10284), Table 1, independently recovered with PyMuPDF clipped text-based table extraction.

confirmed.statement: The baseline-creativity interaction F(4, 237) = 4.42, p = .002 and trust-moderation p > .17 match the text; the form correctly distinguishes these from AI treatment effects.

Participant is supported by the condition-score analyses and explicit within-participant repeated-measures analysis. The form appropriately leaves exact aggregation over ideas, raters, and AI-suggestion comparisons unspecified and does not infer model-specific counts.

Early-AI Round 1 and Late-AI Round 2 explicitly receive GPT-4 suggestions, while Control receives none. All reported task outcomes belong to the same two-round session, supporting immediate timing; no confirmed withdrawal or delayed test is described.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 3-4 (printed pp. 10282-10283), Sections 3.3-3.4 and Figure 1.

confirmed.statement: The cited final-sample arm counts are 50, 49, 49, 50, and 49 for Control, Early-Labeled, Early-Unlabeled, Late-Labeled, and Late-Unlabeled. The form preserves the printed ANOVA degrees of freedom rather than silently reconciling their inconsistency with the stated 247 participants.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3 (printed p. 10282), Section 3.1; PDF p. 4 (printed p. 10283), Section 4.1.

confirmed.statement: No additional qualifying output outcome was found. AUT fluency precedes AI exposure; creative self-efficacy and perceived influence are self-reports; the pilot checks AI stimuli; interviews describe experiences. No across-person diversity measure or confirmed after-AI test appears.
confirmed.locator: PDF pp. 3-6 (printed pp. 10282-10285), Sections 3.3-3.5 and 4.1-4.5; complete markdown reviewed, lines 1-320.

confirmed.statement: The supplied document ends with references on PDF page 9 and contains no appendix or named supplementary source resolving the availability uncertainty.
confirmed.locator: Complete markdown, lines 1-320; PDF pp. 7-9 (printed pp. 10286-10288), conclusion and references.

summary: The shared with_ai code is unsupported for Early-AI Round 2 outputs because continued access to the earlier suggestions is not established. Criterion 3 still holds because experts rated participants’ produced submissions.
